ApiKeyAuth.name: X-Explorer-Auth-Key
ApiKeyAuth.description: Optional. Send your Explorer API key in the `X-Explorer-Auth-Key` header. Requests sent without a key fall back to the default rate limits.

totalRewards.description: Sum of all reward lamports distributed in this block

totalAmountSent.description: Sum of all outgoing lamports in successful transactions

totalComputeUnitsConsumed.description: Sum of compute units consumed by all transactions in the block

transactionCostUtilization.description: Percentage of the block compute limit consumed (0-100+). Limit is epoch-dependent: <770 → 48M, 770-821 → 50M, ≥822 → 60M CU

reservedComputeUnits.description: Sum of compute unit limits requested by all transactions (via ComputeBudget::SetComputeUnitLimit; defaults to 200,000 per tx if not set). Can exceed the block limit.

reservedComputeUnitsUtilization.description: Percentage of the block compute limit reserved by all transactions (reservedComputeUnits / blockComputeLimit * 100)

epoch.description: Solana epoch this block belongs to (slot / 432,000)

computeUnitsConsumed.description: Actual compute units consumed by this transaction

reservedComputeUnits.description: Compute unit limit requested via ComputeBudget::SetComputeUnitLimit (defaults to 200,000 if not set)

computeUnitsUtilization.description: Percentage of reserved compute units actually consumed (computeUnitsConsumed / reservedComputeUnits * 100)

accounts.description: Ordered list of account addresses involved in the instruction

parsed.description: Key-value pairs decoded from instruction data; keys vary by instructionType

identifier.description: "native" for SOL, mint address for SPL tokens

amount.description: Absolute amount in base units (lamports / token decimals)

before.description: Transaction signature cursor — returns transactions older than this value

rentEpoch.description: Next epoch when rent is due; null means rent-exempt

nextPageCursor.description: Pass as "before" in the next request to fetch older transactions; null means no more pages

balance.description: Raw token balance in base units

uri.description: Metadata URI for the token (e.g. link to JSON with name/image)

mempool.description: True if the transaction is unconfirmed

mempoolTime.description: Unix timestamp when the tx entered the mempool

deleted.description: True if the transaction has been deleted/replaced

txid.description: Spending transaction ID; null for coinbase

pkscript.description: Public key script of the output being spent

limit.description: Number of blocks to return (capped at 50)

after.description: Cursor for pagination — block height to start from (inclusive, descending). Omit to start from the current chain tip.

HaskoinBlockSummary.description: Block header with transaction count — returned by the latest-blocks endpoint.

mainchain.description: True if this block is on the main chain

txCount.description: Number of transactions in the block

coinBaseTx.description: Full details of the coinbase (first) transaction in the block; null if unavailable

hash.description: Block hash — exactly 64 hex characters. Provide either hash or height, not both.

height.description: Block height (non-negative integer). Provide either hash or height, not both.

mainchain.description: True if this block is on the main chain

txs.description: Full transaction details for all transactions in the block

fee.description: Total fee paid in Wei (gasUsed * gasPrice)

balance.description: Raw token balance in base units

limit.description: Number of blocks to return (0 is treated as 1; values above 20 are capped at 20)

blockId.description: Block number (non-negative); provide this or hash

hash.description: Block hash; provide this or blockId

fee.description: Total fee paid in Wei (gasUsed * gasPrice)
Total fee paid in Wei (gasUsed * gasPrice)

sampled.description: Apply sampling to reduce data points

unit.description: Unit of measurement for chart values

description.example: The estimated number of gigahashes per second the bitcoin network is performing in the last 24 hours.

ChartFormat.description:
Response format:
- `json` — Returns structured JSON with metadata and values
- `csv` — Returns raw CSV data with timestamp and value columns (no metadata)

PoolTimespan.description:
Time period for pool statistics:
- "24h" — Last 24 hours
- "2d" — Last 2 days
- "4d" — Last 4 days (default)
- "7d" — Last 7 days
- "10d" — Last 10 days
- "6m" — Last 6 months
- "1y" — Last year
- "2y" — Last 2 years
- "3y" — Last 3 years (maximum for pools endpoint)

GetPoolsResponse.description: Map of pool names to block count
